sources.excerpt: joined by Sequoia Capital, SV Angel, Smash Capital, BroadLight Capital and Credo Ventures

sources.title: Investment strategy and portfolio

sources.title: Investment approach, portfolio and contact

sources.title: Sodex Innovations funding announcement
sources.excerpt: Look AI Ventures has joined Sodex Innovations' €4M funding round

sources.title: Investment criteria
sources.summary: States pre-seed to Series A, CEE/SEE/Baltics, equity and convertible instruments, a Prague office, and preferred technology sectors. €6M maximum company allocation is distinct from the initial ticket.

sources.title: Investment focus
sources.summary: States sector agnostic, B2B, B2C and marketplace interests, with Prague office details.

sources.title: grid.online funding report
sources.excerpt: investici 1,5 milionu eur od fondů Reflex Capital, J&T Ventures a Grid Invest
sources.summary: Dated blog entry names grid.online and the three investors in a €1.5M round. The investor-specific amount is not given.

sources.title: Team and contact
sources.summary: Lists Luxembourg fund entities and a Czech contact office. This establishes Czech presence, but main investment management location still requires confirmation.

sources.title: 2024 annual recap
sources.excerpt: Our first investment from Fund 2 was in
sources.summary: Names Dynanic (Brnologic) as Fund 2’s first investment. Describes deep-tech investing and a €50M target for Fund 2, not a final close. Exact transaction date is unspecified.

sources.title: Fund strategy and offices
sources.summary: States pre-seed/seed tickets of $1M–$3M and CEE founders as its focus; lists four international offices. Shows $500M AUM and an $85M current fund without an explicit as-of date.

sources.title: About KAYA VC
sources.summary: Describes KAYA as a Prague-based VC investing in early-stage companies across CEE.

sources.title: Investment areas and portfolio
sources.summary: States AI, crypto/web3, e-commerce, gastrotech and mental-health investment areas. Lists Rossum in its portfolio and reports €450M portfolio value, which is not AUM. Stage, ticket and dated transaction evidence remain incomplete.

sources.title: Membership directory
sources.summary: Discovery source only. Membership includes VC, PE and service providers. Neither membership nor a Czech address alone proves eligibility. Financial fields are not imported from this directory.
